task: Forward authoring test: two same-typed robot resources, fallible custom node, handled failure, subsequent reuse, creator lifecycle

design.devices_and_cadence: Two independent BenchArm instances with immediate-completion mock point-to-point JointSpace<2> motion; no periodic control session needed.
design.rhythm_layers: One once() child failure-isolation domain, then parent outcome handling and separate park MotionNodes.
node_responsibilities: PositionFixture borrows both arms and issues ordered motion
RetireFixture handles Execution and chooses parking goals
MotionNode performs one parking move per resource
design.creation: Both arms and nodes are parent-System-created; parent calls init once and reverse-order shutdown.
design.communication: Business goals use graph edges; resources use separate resources.0/1 slots; Journal is mock-backend observation only.

versions.note: Both source repositories have existing migration changes; the tested sources are the local working trees, not just those HEAD commits.

checks.result: passed; right rejected after left accepted, both parked, right then left shutdown
expected compile rejection E0382: borrow of moved local arm

findings.finding: Unqualified tail Ok(arm) guidance immediately follows local-creation lifecycle wording. A locally created lifecycle-managed resource cannot be returned by value because shutdown still borrows it. External by-value parameter return compiles.
findings.suggestion: Qualify Ok(arm) to externally supplied objects; use business-state snapshots for locally created resources.

findings.source: robot-behavior/references/implement-robot-driver.md import rule and Robot/MoveTo snippets; use-robot-driver import rule
findings.finding: driver::* and behavior::* do not export RobotResult or RobotException; initial authoring compile produced E0425/E0433 until explicit root imports were added.
findings.suggestion: Add use robot_behavior::{RobotException, RobotResult} where the snippets need these types.

observed_warnings: Existing nightly generic_const_exprs next-solver fallback warning
limits: Device-free finite mock only. No hardware, network, GUI, repository edits, commits, or pushes. The probes workspace intentionally includes one noncompiling binary.

resolutions.lifecycle_wording: Qualified in current core syntax and skill syntax/application-design: return externally supplied objects by value; local Lifecycle-managed objects remain through shutdown.
resolutions.error_imports: Both driver guides now identify RobotResult and RobotException as explicit root imports.
